claims.content: To resolve differences in Environment/Category, Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator field values for a track received from another unit.

goal.raw_text: To resolve differences in Environment/Category, Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator field values for a track received from another unit.

claims.content: C2 JU
A track report has been received containing a PPLI Track Number.
The Identity Indicator in the received track report is set to value 1.
The new identity contained in the track report is Friend.
The locally held identity for the track is not Hostile.

A C2 JU elects to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU elects to accept, automatically, changes in Environment/Category, Identity or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

claims.content: The C2 JU accepts the changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator received in the track report.
The C2 JU evaluates the Platform/Platform Activity/Specific Type and Special Interest Indicator field values for difference resolution.

If a change in the ID of the track is accepted, the C2 JU includes the appropriate evaluation of the Platform/Platform Activity/Specific Type and Special Interest Indicator fields in the J3.X or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message.

When accepting a remote ID change, the C2 JU retains the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission and operator appreciation.
If the C2 JU is a controlling unit, it shall follow the rules specified in paragraphs 4.7.1.2.2b and c regarding Platform/Platform Activity/Specific Type difference resolution.

If a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU does not retain the received zero value during the resolution of differences.
If an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker (Boom Only)), or 8 (Tanker (Drogue Only)) is held locally and a different value is received, the C2 JU may optionally generate an operator alert.

If a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU does not retain the received zero value during the resolution of differences.
If an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker (Boom Only)), or 8 (Tanker (Drogue Only)) is held locally and a different value is received, the C2 JU may optionally generate an operator alert.
The C2 JU has accepted the changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator from the received track report.
The Platform/Platform Activity/Specific Type and Special Interest Indicator field values have been evaluated for difference resolution.
If a change in the ID of the track was accepted, the evaluation of the Platform/Platform Activity/Specific Type and Special Interest Indicator fields is included in a J3.X or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message.
The received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields are retained by the C2 JU for retransmission and operator appreciation.
